latestVersion.changelog:
TikTok Video Generator AI — Initial Release

- Generate TikTok-ready videos from video clips or images using AI.
- Supports MP4, MOV, JPG, and PNG files up to 500MB.
- Automated cloud rendering delivers 1080p MP4 output in 30–60 seconds.
- Includes features for aspect ratio, text overlays, trending music, and auto-captioning.
- Anonymous token system with free credits for fast onboarding and simple setup.
- Designed for TikTok creators seeking quick, AI-assisted short-form video production.
